say:1:1122320001:1.text: The bandits have even got their claws in intel brokers and bounty hunters? Tsk... how troublesome.
say:1:1122320001:1.source_cn: 盗匪居然收买了赏金猎人？\n啧……还真是棘手。

say:2:1122320002:1.text: Good thing I had the brilliant idea to send you in disguise. You got us this vital information.
say:2:1122320002:1.source_cn: 多亏了我派你去做伪装训练，才能获得这么关键的情报。
say:2:1122320002:1.male: Good thing I had the brilliant idea to send you in disguise. You got us this vital information.
say:2:1122320002:1.female: Good thing I had the brilliant idea to send you in disguise. You got us this vital information.

say:4:1122320003:1.text: Alright, alright. I admit it, you're due credit too. Looks like you've mastered the art of disguises.
say:4:1122320003:1.source_cn: 好吧，我承认，你也功不可没。赏金猎人的伪装技能，也就算...
say:4:1122320003:1.male: Alright, alright. I admit it, you're due credit too. Looks like you've mastered the art of disguises.
say:4:1122320003:1.female: Alright, alright. I admit it, you're due credit too. Looks like you've mastered the art of disguises.

say:5:1122320004:1.text: I've sent Wildclaw to scout the bandit camp. It'll take some time, I'm not sure when he'll get back.
say:5:1122320004:1.source_cn: 我已经派烈爪去探查盗匪营地的具体位置和内部情况了，估计...

say:6:1122320005:1.text: And with the info you just got, this means we gotta thoroughly prepare, just in case.
say:6:1122320005:1.source_cn: 而且，根据你们刚刚带回的消息，我们也得多做准备，以防万一。

say:7:1122320006:1.text: Soon as we're set, I'll let you know. In the meantime, brush up on your bounty hunter skills!
say:7:1122320006:1.source_cn: 等所有准备都完成了，我会通知你的。在那之前，你就先好好...
